fact: In July 2026 the Central Bank of Somalia announced plans to expand the SIPS instant payment system (live since January 2025) to connect 14 commercial banks and 8 mobile money providers, and to link SIPS to PAPSS before the end of 2026.
title: Soomaaliya oo dardar gelinaysa casriyeynta nidaamka lacag-bixinta dalka.
